course_name_original: Recherche et optimisation combinatoire modèles et méthodes
course_name_en: Combinatorial research and optimization models and methods

learning_outcomes.text: design and use a simple experimental design
Understand the problems and issues involved in designs of experiments
Be able to use a design of experiments and understand the design of fractional designs of experiments
Be able to conceptually define an assembly line and its essential components.
Be able to model and solve a line balancing problem by applying the appropriate methods.
Be able to analyse and evaluate a balancing solution in order to identify its strengths and weaknesses.

syllabus_topics: Practical interest and general principles of design of experiments
Determination of a numerical model from a design of experiments
Design of a design of experiments by reduction of a complete design, taking into account the loss of information caused by the reduction
The case of assembly lines: characteristics and specificities
The problem of balancing assembly lines
Definition and typology of line balancing problems
Exact methods (formulation by linear programming and simplex solving)
Approximate methods (principle and implementation of the RPW algorithm)
bibliography: Les plans d'expériences par la méthode Taguchi, Maurice Pillet, Paris : les Éditions d'Organisation, 1997
Introduction aux plans d'expériences, Jacques Goupy, Paris : Dunod, 2001 2ème édition - Technique et in-génierie, Série Conception
Supply Chain Engineering. Useful Methods and Techniques, Alexandre Dolgui and Jean-Marie Proth, 2010
degree: Titre d'ingénieur ENIT (cycle ingénieur, semestres 5-10; orientación mecánica/producción)
